title: 我对友谊与社交的看法(My View on friendship)
summary: 两人就友谊与社交深入交流,互相给出建议。

sentences.en: Good to see you, Leo. How is everything going?
sentences.zh: 见到你真好,利奥。最近怎么样?

sentences.en: How did you get started with it?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么开始做这件事的?

sentences.en: I am planning to travel to Rome with my family in September.
sentences.zh: 我打算九月和家人去罗马旅行。

sentences.en: I usually relax by cooking chicken at home.
sentences.zh: 我通常在家做鸡肉来放松。

sentences.en: My dream is to work as a doctor in the future.
sentences.zh: 我的梦想是将来当医生。

sentences.en: Maybe you could look at it from another side.
sentences.zh: 也许你可以从另一个角度看看。

sentences.en: In fact, send me a DM with the details.
sentences.zh: 细节私信我。

sentences.en: Also, happy hour ends at seven.
sentences.zh: 欢乐时光七点结束。

sentences.en: Let us catch up again soon.
sentences.zh: 我们回头再聊。

title: 在搜索页面的一段对话(A Conversation at the search page)
summary: 两人就网络生活深入交流,互相给出建议。

sentences.en: Good to see you, Max. How is everything going?
sentences.zh: 见到你真好,马克斯。最近怎么样?

sentences.en: How do you manage your time between study and hobbies?
sentences.zh: 你怎么安排学习和爱好的时间?

sentences.en: My dream is to work as a teacher in the future.
sentences.zh: 我的梦想是将来当老师。

sentences.en: I am planning to travel to Xi'an with my family in February.
sentences.zh: 我打算二月和家人去西安旅行。

sentences.en: I usually spend my weekend at the bookstore reading or taking notes.
sentences.zh: 我周末通常在书店阅读或记笔记。

sentences.en: I had almost the same problem last year.
sentences.zh: 我去年也遇到过几乎一样的问题。

sentences.en: For example, the fire made the front page.
sentences.zh: 火灾上了头版。

sentences.en: What's more, his sister is pregnant with her first child.
sentences.zh: 他姐姐怀上了第一个孩子。

sentences.en: Let us catch up again soon.
sentences.zh: 我们回头再聊。
